accruals.formula: (TTM net income - TTM operating cash flow) / total assets (Sloan 1996)

asset_growth.formula: total assets / total assets one year earlier - 1 (base > 0)

cash_conversion.formula: (TTM operating cash flow - TTM capital expenditure) / TTM net income, net income > 0

cash_flow_margin.formula: TTM operating cash flow / TTM revenue

cash_flow_quality.formula: TTM operating cash flow / TTM net income, net income > 0

cash_profitability.formula: TTM operating cash flow / total assets

days_since_report.formula: calendar days since the latest report became usable

earnings_growth.formula: (TTM net income - year-ago TTM) / year-ago total assets

ebitda_margin.formula: (TTM operating income + TTM depreciation & amortisation) / TTM revenue

equity_issuance_proxy.formula: ((equity - year-ago equity) - TTM net income) / year-ago assets: equity change not explained by earnings

fcf_growth.formula: (TTM free cash flow - year-ago TTM) / year-ago total assets

fcf_yield.formula: (TTM operating cash flow - TTM capital expenditure) / market capitalisation

filing_lag_days.formula: days from the latest report's period end to its acceptance

gross_margin_stability.formula: - standard deviation of TTM gross margin over the last (up to) 8 filings, >= 5 observations

gross_profit_growth.formula: (TTM gross profit - year-ago TTM) / year-ago total assets

gross_profitability.formula: TTM gross profit / total assets (Novy-Marx 2013); gross profit = GrossProfit, else revenue - cost of revenue

liabilities_to_assets.formula: total liabilities / total assets; liabilities = Liabilities, else assets - equity

ocf_growth.formula: (TTM operating cash flow - year-ago TTM) / year-ago total assets

ocf_yield.formula: TTM operating cash flow / market capitalisation

operating_income_growth.formula: (TTM operating income - year-ago TTM) / year-ago total assets

operating_income_to_ev.formula: TTM operating income / enterprise value; EV = market cap + (long-term + short-term debt) - cash

roa_stability.formula: - standard deviation of TTM ROA over the last (up to) 8 filings, >= 5 observations

roe.formula: TTM net income / stockholders' equity, equity > 0

seasonal_ni_surprise.formula: (discrete-quarter net income - same quarter a year earlier) / std of the previous 8 such differences (>= 4)

shares_growth.formula: split-adjusted shares outstanding / shares one year (365 days) earlier - 1

working_capital_growth.formula: change in non-cash working capital [(current assets - cash) - current liabilities] / year-ago assets

macro_vintage_status: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_FRED_KEY: baseline rates features use the Treasury curve with a one-session lag; no ALFRED vintage series exist

missingness_vs_exit.reading: a lower 'present' share for names that exit soon means missingness itself reveals a future delisting
